findings.description: S-220's early probe of A-022 uses `python3 -m pytest -m reference -k accordion -s`. No reference test item has 'accordion' in its name: they are test_T200_*[pp|mf|ff] and test_T201_*[harmonica|melodion|mandolin|bouzouki] in test_reference.py. On a scratch copy of tests/, collection gives 'no tests collected (361 deselected)', exit status 5; `-m reference -k T200` gives 11.
findings.conditions: none: the command as written selects nothing
findings.root_cause: The selector was chosen from the instrument name, not from the collected node ids, and the command was never collected before the plan text was frozen
findings.traces_to: PLAN.md S-220 Done when; R-128 mitigation; A-022
findings.failure_path: Implementer runs the command locally -> pytest exit 5, no test run -> 'run once and result recorded' is satisfied with an empty run, or the implementer must guess a selector -> the A-022 structural miss is found only at S-330 -> DR-07 rounds are used up -> the accordion ships with a failed reference comparison (DR-16)
findings.mitigation: Replace `-k accordion` with `-k T200` in S-220's Done when. Require the record to give the number of tests run (11) with their pass or fail lines, and state that exit status 5 or 'no tests collected' means the probe did not run.
findings.mitigation_adds: The probe actually executes T-200a to T-200e against the first accordion build, and a vacuous run can no longer be recorded as a result.

findings.description: S-220's Done when lets the probe run 'in the next CI reference job, rule DR-13' and says a failure 'does not fail this step'. DR-13 says 'the step is done only when that job is green'. The reference job stays red on T-200 until S-330 calibrates, and S-330 depends on S-300, which depends on S-220.
findings.conditions: The local TinySOL run is not possible (sandbox recycled or no network), so the CI route is used, and T-200 fails before calibration, which is what S-330 exists for
findings.root_cause: Rule DR-13 was cited for the route without exempting this probe from DR-13's green condition
findings.traces_to: PLAN.md S-220 Done when; DECISIONS.md DR-13; S-300 and S-330 Depends on
findings.failure_path: CI route -> reference job red on T-200 -> DR-13: S-220 not done -> S-300 cannot start -> S-330 cannot calibrate -> deadlock, or the implementer guesses which text wins
findings.mitigation: In S-220 (and the DR-13 row), state that DR-13 governs only where the probe runs: the step is done once a CI reference run on a commit containing the accordion has finished and its T-200 lines are copied into EXECUTION_LOG.md, green or red.
findings.mitigation_adds: Removes the cycle S-220 -> reference green -> S-330 -> S-300 -> S-220 and the guess between the two texts.

findings.description: Pilot-gate question 4 invites rescoping instruments, variants, formats and platforms. The proceed-with-rescope branch says to apply a reduction 'for example dropping a variant', and to write BLOCKED.md only when the text 'asks for' a change to a frozen test. Every variant and instrument is frozen (param_table.h, test_strings.py, test_harmonica.py, kAllInstruments in T-013 and T-016, the ctest count of 7, the CI matrix), so the plan's own example makes frozen tests unpassable.
findings.conditions: The owner answers question 4 with a reduction (the intake defaults were adopted after a one-word 'Resume', so the question exists to invite this)
findings.root_cause: Question 4 widened what a pilot gate asks about without updating the branch, whose example predates the question and conflicts with HANDOFF's immutability rule and DR-15
findings.traces_to: plan/GATES.md G-P1/G-P2 question 4 and branches; R-116; DR-15; HANDOFF.md section 1 (Immutability, Default rule)
findings.failure_path: Owner: 'proceed-with-rescope: drop the Irish bouzouki variant' -> implementer applies it as a reduction, per the example -> at S-260 the frozen variant-2 cases cannot pass -> TEST_CHALLENGE and a halt weeks later; or the implementer must guess between applying and blocking at the gate
findings.mitigation: Replace the example with a reduction that touches no frozen test (a factory preset, a demo). Add: 'dropping an instrument, a variant, a format or a platform changes frozen tests or ci.yml: write BLOCKED.md at once naming the tests and workflow lines, for the planning agent; continue the steps it does not touch'. Show this in the gate record next to question 4.
findings.mitigation_adds: The rescope is routed at the gate, not discovered at S-260 or S-300; the owner sees what the answer costs; the implementer has nothing to guess.

findings.description: S-201's Checkpoint takes 'the cost of one reed per sample' from a timing of 450 periods at 444 Hz by reed_probe. At 444 Hz, m = ceil(C f/(4 fs)) = 1 for both C = 110 and C = 160: the cheapest case. reed_probe has no internal timer, so the whole process is timed: about 2.8 ms of reed work (from S05) against process start, table build and JSON. The run is on the local machine, not the runner, with no threshold or decision rule. C = 160 and the high ranks (m = 2 or 3 at MIDI 87 to 99), named by the audit for A-009, are not measured.
findings.conditions: The runner is slower than the local machine, or C = 160 and the 4' rank erode the 5.6x S05 margin
findings.root_cause: An early-warning measurement without a derived budget, timed outside the workload; against past lessons L-20261004T102002Z and L-20261009T150301Z
findings.traces_to: PLAN.md S-201 Checkpoint; R-120; A-009; D-011; D-014
findings.failure_path: Timing shows headroom -> no early action -> S-320 shows the accordion below 4x -> DR-06 cuts polyphony late (a documented workaround; T-013 still gates)
findings.mitigation: (Suggested; Medium) Time 64 reeds over the T-013 key range in-process (steady_clock around the step loop) at C = 110 and C = 160, and state the factor that would trigger DR-06 thinking.
findings.mitigation_adds: Turns the checkpoint into a measurement of the workload T-013 gates.

findings.description: S-330 action 2 runs `FOLK_PERF_GATE=1 $B/folk-perf` locally after each calibration round. With the variable set, T-013 CHECKs factor >= 4 and the program exits non-zero. D-086 confines gating to the ubuntu-24.04 runner, and S-300 says a local factor below 4 'is not a failure'.
findings.conditions: The local factor drops below 4 after a round that raises C to 160
findings.root_cause: A gated command used only to record figures that print without the gate
findings.traces_to: PLAN.md S-330 action 2; D-086; S-300 On failure; DR-06; DR-07
findings.failure_path: A red local perf run is read as a regression -> a needed calibration round is reverted (a DR-07 round lost), or DR-06 is applied on sandbox figures
findings.mitigation: (Suggested; Medium) Drop FOLK_PERF_GATE=1 from S-330 action 2 and say that local factors are recorded, not acted on.
findings.mitigation_adds: Removes a false red signal during calibration.

findings.description: The ENVIRONMENT section 5 row TP-T304-1 says 'Catch2 prints both counts when a CHECK fails'. Catch2 prints only the failing CHECK's expansion. The auditor's proposal to print both counts on every run was not adopted, so the T-304 margin under ThreadSanitizer is never seen while S-330 and later fixes add cost.
findings.root_cause: The mitigation was summarised more strongly than what was adopted
findings.traces_to: plan/ENVIRONMENT.md section 5 row TP-T304-1; R-130; tests/juce/host_test.cpp T-304
findings.failure_path: A near-miss passes unseen; a later change tips it into an intermittent red host-tsan, handled by the TEST_CHALLENGE route (loud)

findings.description: The T-302 locale case switches the C and C++ global locales and restores them with a plain call at the end, not with RAII like T-016's RestoreC. An exception between the two leaves the later test cases of the same host program under a comma locale.
findings.conditions: An exception escapes from the wrapper inside the locale case
findings.root_cause: Restore by statement instead of a scope guard
findings.failure_path: Exception -> Catch2 records the failure -> the later cases run under de_DE -> cascading failures (never a false pass)

findings.description: The widened host-tsan object check reads nm symbols. GCC slim LTO objects carry no __tsan_* reference, because the tsan pass and its constructor run at link time, so a correctly instrumented LTO build fails the check, which ENVIRONMENT section 5 calls 'a defect, never an exception'.
findings.conditions: LTO is enabled for the ThreadSanitizer build (nothing in the plan does so)
findings.root_cause: The check infers instrumentation from object symbols
findings.traces_to: plan/ci/ci.yml host-tsan object check; ENVIRONMENT.md section 5 row
findings.failure_path: LTO build -> check fails on every object -> the implementer investigates and drops LTO (loud, evident remedy)

findings.description: Accepting __tsan_init reduces the check to 'compiled with -fsanitize=thread'. It no longer detects --param=tsan-instrument-func-entry-exit=0, which only removes caller frames from reports.
findings.failure_path: none: race detection and the top-frame rules are unaffected

findings.description: The T-302 locale case checks only a round trip within one locale; it never checks the blob for commas or a load across locales.
findings.failure_path: none: the only wrapper-specific content is '#program <int>', locale-proof below 1000; T-016 covers the engine text

findings.description: The re-frozen locale tests were verified red against the stubs only; no default-stream mutant was run (L-20261029T000000Z, L-20261009T234102Z).
findings.failure_path: none: the find(',') check and the round trip catch writing or reading with the global stream; setCommaLocale itself executed in the red run

findings.description: The core job's Linux locale step runs `apt-get install locales` without `apt-get update`, unlike the plugins and host-tsan jobs; the package is unpinned.
findings.conditions: A runner image without the locales package and with empty apt lists
findings.root_cause: Copy of the step without the index refresh
findings.traces_to: plan/ci/ci.yml core job 'Locale for the locale tests (T-016)'; ENVIRONMENT.md row TP-LOC-1
findings.failure_path: The step fails loudly -> core job red until the step is fixed

findings.description: D-064 now states 'within 11.3 dB' and 'a spread of 11.2 dB' for the same three levels. Both hold for 11.23 dB, but two bounds in one sentence invite reading one as a threshold (T-146 uses 30 dB).
findings.root_cause: Correction added a second figure beside the first

summary: Round 6, limited to the steps changed by the assumption audit: 13 findings, 10 counted (new or residual) and 3 speculative. No Critical. Three High: F1 (residual R-128, expected) S-220's `-k accordion` collects no reference test (verified: exit 5, 361 deselected), so the A-022 probe never runs; F2 (new, plausible) S-220's 'failure does not fail this step' against DR-13's 'done only when green' makes a dependency cycle through S-330 and S-300; F3 (new, plausible) pilot-gate question 4's rescope branch gives 'dropping a variant' as an example, though every variant is frozen. Two Medium (F4 residual R-120: S-201's per-reed timing at 444 Hz measures the cheapest case and mostly process overhead; F5: S-330's local FOLK_PERF_GATE=1 run conflicts with D-086 and S-300). Five Low counted. The locale amendments (D-090, T-016, the T-302 locale case) and the widened host-tsan object check hold up: no Critical or High failure path was found in them.
